critical_rule.title: Never Expose Internal Tool Calls
critical_rule.description: DO NOT output raw function calls, MCP invocations, or tool call syntax in user-facing responses.

what_not_to_show.example: MCP server method names with double underscores

what_to_show_instead.example: "Taking a screenshot of the current page..."
Clean, natural language descriptions of what you're doing

output_format_rules.rule: Describe actions in plain English — never show tool signatures
Show results, not method calls — present the output of commands, not the command syntax
Hide infrastructure details — MCP server names, method IDs, and parameter structures are internal
Present debug findings clearly — focus on what the user needs to know about their code

step.format: Actual findings, code snippets, error messages

example.name: good_clean_output
example.output:
I found one page open: Home (ID: 1).
Taking a screenshot to inspect the current state...
[Screenshot attached or described]
The page shows the expected layout with the navigation bar visible at the top.
